headline: LS Cable Borrows 500 Billion Won Without Paying a Single Won of Interest… How Was It Possible? [Disclosure Insight]
summary: LS Cable, an unlisted subsidiary of LS, issued exchangeable bonds and raised 500 billion won interest-free. Exchangeable bonds carry an exchange right that allows conversion into shares, unlike ordinary corporate bonds.
why: LS Cable is a South Korean cable maker; exchangeable bonds can later convert into equity, potentially diluting shareholders of the related listed company.
